title: [banking_knowledge] task_086: gold liability amounts need a statement date that the task never gives
body:
## Summary

In task 086, each debit dispute sets `customer_max_liability_amount`. The KB rule bases this amount on the statement date. No statement date exists anywhere in the task. Gold can only be reproduced if the statement closes between the 12th and the 30th of the month. A statement on the 1st or at month-end gives a different answer for one dispute.

Checked on main `5bfa7e3` (2026-09-28). Task 086 and doc 031 are the same at `672227c`.

## The rule

`doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031`:

> Before proceeding, inform the customer of their liability exposure based on when they noticed the unauthorized activity:
> - Reported within 2 business days of statement: Maximum liability $50
> - Reported within 60 days of statement: Maximum liability $500
> - Reported after 60 days: Unlimited liability - customer may not recover funds

## No statement date is available

| # | Source | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `db.json` | 0 occurrences of "statement". No key contains statement, billing, cycle or closing. |
| 2 | `tasks/task_086.json` | "statement" appears only as "written statement" (the customer's own account of the dispute) and in the `written_statement_provided` field. |
| 3 | `tools.py` | No tool returns a statement date. `apply_statement_credit_8472` only writes a credit. All 59 agent tools in this file were checked, 45 of them discoverable. |
| 4 | Agent prompts | None of the 17 files in `prompts/` mentions a statement date or cycle. |
| 5 | KB documents | Of 698 documents, some use generic phrases such as "statement cycle" or "statement period". None gives a date or a cycle day. No document ties a debit or checking statement to the account opening date. |

The customer gives only the charge date and the date they noticed it. `get_current_time` returns 2025-11-14, so every dispute is reported on 2025-11-14.

## Gold cannot be derived from the rule

Gold for the five debit disputes:

| # | Transaction | Charged | Noticed | Gold liability |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `btxn_c671c90e2724` | 11/07/2025 | 11/07/2025 | $50 |
| 2 | `btxn_a917670d8aaa` | 10/31/2025 | 11/09/2025 | $50 |
| 3 | `btxn_0fae026130ee` | 11/08/2025 | 11/09/2025 | $50 |
| 4 | `btxn_5690acdd3de5` | 10/04/2025 | 11/14/2025 | $500 |
| 5 | `btxn_0788d2513c8c` | 11/06/2025 | 11/08/2025 | $50 |

The rule applied with a monthly statement closing on day N:

| # | Closing day N | Gold values reproduced | Disagreements |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 to 5 | 4 of 5 | `btxn_a917670d8aaa` gives $500 |
| 2 | 6 | 3 of 5 | also `btxn_0788d2513c8c` gives $500 |
| 3 | 7 | 2 of 5 | also `btxn_c671c90e2724` gives $500 |
| 4 | 8 to 11 | 1 of 5 | also `btxn_0fae026130ee` gives $500 |
| 5 | 12 to 30 | 5 of 5 | none |
| 6 | 31 | 4 of 5 | `btxn_a917670d8aaa` gives $500 |

On the 1st or at month-end, the 10/31 and 10/04 charges land on the same statement and are reported the same day, so the rule must give them the same amount. Gold gives $50 and $500.

A statement that closes on each account's opening day is another natural guess. The Green Fee-Free account opened 04/15/2023 (day 15) and the Evergreen account opened 08/10/2021 (day 10). This reading matches 3 of 5 gold values. It gives $500 for `btxn_0fae026130ee` and `btxn_0788d2513c8c`, where gold gives $50.

The "noticed" reading does not reproduce gold either. Four disputes were reported 5 business days after the customer noticed them, yet gold gives $50. The fifth (`btxn_5690acdd3de5`) was reported the day it was noticed, yet gold gives $500.

The doc also does not say which tier applies to a charge not yet on any statement. The sweep assumes $50.

## Public leaderboard trajectories

I checked the 28 public submissions that include banking_knowledge trajectories (4 trials each, 3 for glm-5-think).

- Task 086 passed in 0 of 110 graded trials. One more trial ended in an infrastructure error.
- Of 477 successful filings on the five gold transactions, 32.1% carry the gold liability.
- On `btxn_a917670d8aaa`, the dispute that flips with the closing day, 8.2% of the 110 trials filed $500. On `btxn_5690acdd3de5` (gold $500), 15% filed $50.
- 10 trials filed all five liabilities at gold and still failed on other parts of the task. The zero pass count therefore does not isolate this defect. The point of this issue is that gold cannot be derived from the information the agent has.

## Reproduction

`repro.py` uses the standard library only. It reads `task_086.json`, `db.json`, doc 031 and `tools.py` from a checkout. Run it from the repository root with `python3 repro.py`.

<details>
<summary>repro.py</summary>

```python
"""task_086: gold customer_max_liability_amount needs a statement date that no source provides.

Run from a tau2-bench checkout root, or pass the directory holding task_086.json, db.json,
doc031.json and tools.py. Standard library only.
"""
import datetime as D
import json
import os
import re
import sys

base = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "data/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge"
def path(name, sub):
    p = os.path.join(base, name)
    return p if os.path.exists(p) else os.path.join(base, sub)

task = json.load(open(path("task_086.json", "tasks/task_086.json")))
db = open(path("db.json", "db.json")).read()
doc = json.load(open(path("doc031.json", "documents/doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031.json")))
tools = open(path("tools.py", "../../../../src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/tools.py")).read()

print("1. Liability rule in doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031:")
for line in doc["content"].splitlines():
    if "liability" in line.lower():
        print("   ", line.strip())

print("\n2. Is a statement date available anywhere?")
script = task["user_scenario"]["instructions"]
script = script if isinstance(script, str) else json.dumps(script)
stmt_keys = sorted(set(re.findall(r'"(\w*(?:statement|billing|cycle|closing)\w*)"\s*:', db)))
print("   db.json keys containing statement/billing/cycle/closing:", stmt_keys or "none")
print("   'statement' in db.json:", len(re.findall(r"(?i)statement", db)), "occurrences")
print("   'statement' in the task_086 user script, other than 'written statement':",
      len([m for m in re.finditer(r"(?i)statement", script) if "written" not in script[max(0, m.start() - 9):m.start()].lower()]))
print("   agent tools returning a statement date:",
      [n for n in re.findall(r"def (\w+)\(", tools) if "statement" in n] or "none", "(apply_statement_credit_8472 writes a credit, it does not read a date)")
now = re.search(r"The current time is (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})", tools).group(1)
print("   get_current_time returns:", now)

TODAY = D.date.fromisoformat(now)
def d(s):
    m, dd, y = map(int, s.split("/"))
    return D.date(y, m, dd)
gold = []
for a in task["evaluation_criteria"]["actions"]:
    ar = a.get("arguments") or {}
    if ar.get("agent_tool_name") == "file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281" and "arguments" in ar:
        g = json.loads(ar["arguments"]) if isinstance(ar["arguments"], str) else ar["arguments"]
        gold.append(g)
print(f"\n3. Gold debit disputes ({len(gold)}):")
for g in gold:
    print(f"   {g['transaction_id']}  {g['dispute_category']:<28} charged {g['transaction_date']}  "
          f"noticed {g['discovery_date']}  gold liability {g['customer_max_liability_amount']}")

def add_bdays(x, n):
    while n:
        x += D.timedelta(1)
        n -= x.weekday() < 5
    return x
def statement_for(charge, day):
    y, m = charge.year, charge.month
    while True:
        try:
            s = D.date(y, m, day)
            if s >= charge:
                return s
        except ValueError:
            pass
        y, m = (y + 1, 1) if m == 12 else (y, m + 1)
def tier(statement, reported):
    if reported < statement:
        return 50  # not yet on a statement; the doc does not cover this case, $50 assumed
    if reported <= add_bdays(statement, 2):
        return 50
    return 500 if reported <= statement + D.timedelta(60) else "unlimited"

print(f"\n4. Doc rule applied with a monthly statement closing on day N, reported {TODAY}:")
fits = []
for day in range(1, 32):
    miss = []
    for g in gold:
        want = g["customer_max_liability_amount"]
        got = tier(statement_for(d(g["transaction_date"]), day), TODAY)
        if got != want:
            miss.append(f"{g['transaction_id']} gives {got}, gold {want}")
    if not miss:
        fits.append(day)
    print(f"   N={day:>2}: {len(gold) - len(miss)} of {len(gold)} match" + (f"  ({'; '.join(miss)})" if miss else ""))
print(f"\n   Closing days that reproduce every gold value: {fits[0]}-{fits[-1]}" if fits else "\n   No closing day reproduces gold.")
```

</details>

## Suggested fix

Give the statement date to the agent (for example a statement closing day on the account record, referenced in doc 031), or restate the rule in terms of the noticed date and update gold.

## Scope

Tasks 082, 084, 085, 087 and 088 use the same rule and can disagree with gold depending on the closing day assumed. This issue is limited to 086, where the most natural guess already fails.
